newsitem.title: USA: Massachusetts doctors' report cards available.
newsitem.headline: Massachusetts doctors' report cards available.

text.p: Massachusetts Thursday launched the nation's first consumer hotline on physicians, allowing patients to check up on their doctors' malpractice and disciplinary history, as well as other professional information.

The database of 27,000 physician profiles can be tapped through an 800-number operated by the state's Board of Registry in Medicine and will be available on the Internet and CD Rom next May, officials said.

Other states have shown interest in compiling similar "doctor report cards," which detail citations in malpractice suits, disciplinary action by the medical board and criminal charges, as well as education and awards.
"We have received calls from governors' offices and health care advocates from around the country," said Kim Hinden of the Executive Office of Consumer Affairs.
Under the new system, consumers can request by name up to 10 physician report cards at a time. The information is faxed or mailed to them the same day.
